product.name: AI Workspace
product.description: A secure, web-based interface that allows employees to interact with multiple large language models (LLMs) from one platform, supporting text, document, image, and audio inputs with access controls and usage monitoring.

product.name: AI Gateway
product.description: A centralized API service that manages, routes, and secures all large language model traffic, providing features like fallback logic, caching, observability, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) support.
